comparison: Le Rouge 1756 Spain-Portugal frontier vs Sanson/Vaugondy 1762
reason: a segment-by-segment distance comparison needs both lines on the ground, and the Vaugondy sheets are not georeferenced: the plate draws towns as pictorial vignettes and no defensible anchor rule exists for them yet. Comparing an unplaced trace against a placed one would produce a number with no meaning.
what_would_be_reported: per-segment median, p75, p90, p95 and maximum distance, each segment classified WITHIN_COMBINED_UNCERTAINTY / SOURCE_DISAGREEMENT / TEMPORAL_CHANGE_POSSIBLE / SPECIAL_CASE / UNRESOLVED
averaging_forbidden: YES - the two lines would never be averaged; a disagreement widens the UNRESOLVED band instead
independence: UNRESOLVED in both directions, so even a completed comparison could not count as independent corroboration
